response.rationale: Both answers correctly identify a dishwashing sponge. Indonesian “spons cuci piring” is supported by Indonesian lexical and usage sources; Malaysian Malay “span pencuci pinggan” is supported by DBP and Malaysian usage sources. The forms are distinct common lexical forms, so the relation is appropriate. They are related loanword variants, not false friends; an explicit contrast is unnecessary.
